subject: Re: Clarify post-billing treatment for promotional credit / invoice clearing
messages:
From: Tom Liao <tom.liao@sprout.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sprout AI Finance <finance@sprout.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promotional credit / invoice clearing question

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the trial extension for our analytics team — much appreciated. Finance has asked for guidance on how the $12,500 promotional credit we applied in September should be reflected on our August invoice (Invoice #2027-08-31).

Options they suggested:
- Post a credit memo and apply it to the open invoice (invoice offset).
- Issue a negative line on a new invoice and let us net it on our AR side.

They need a recommended approach from you (or your accounting team) so their ERP posting matches Redwood's ledger. Specific asks:
1) If you issue a credit memo, what GLA(s) should Sprout map it to?
2) Will Redwood accept invoice-offsetting the August invoice, or do you prefer a separate credit memos to be paid/settled?
3) Any required reference fields we should include to ensure automated reconciliation (e.g., credit_memo_id, original_invoice_id)?

I can loop in our AP team if you prefer direct coordination. We referenced your credit policy but wanted something explicit for our auditors.

Appreciate the help — deadline for their month-end posting is this Thursday.

Best,
Tom
Tom Liao
Head of Finance, Sprout AI
T: 415-555-0189

Marcus / Laura,

Looping you in — Sprout (external) applied a $12,500 promo credit tied to a trial extension. They asked whether we prefer an invoice-offset vs. standalone credit memo and which GLA(s) we want them to map to for automated reconciliation. They need this for month-end posting (this Thursday).

Attachment: Sprout_invoice_2027-08-31.pdf (attached by Tom).

My propose approach (happy to defer to accounting):
- Issue a Redwood credit memo (Credit Memo ID: CM-09321) and authorize application against Invoice #2027-08-31 (offset).
- Use the following references: original_invoice_id=2027-08-31, credit_memo_id=CM-09321, external_reference=SproutAI-PO-7781.
- Ledger mapping suggestion: debit Contra Revenue (GLA 4105) / credit Accounts Receivable (GLA 1200) to clear the open invoice.

Can you confirm the GLAs and whether we need any tax-specific note for their auditor? If you prefer a different flow (e.g., separate credit memo kept open instead of auto-applying), say so and I will tell Tom.

Thanks — Steph

Subject: Re: Fwd: Promotional credit / invoice clearing question — GLA guidance

Stephanie / Laura,

Thanks for the context. Recommended treatment below (well post once we receive signed credit memo authorization):

1) Posting approach (preferred): Issue a credit memo (CM-09321) and apply it to Invoice #2027-08-31. This keeps AR clean and aligns with how we treat promotional allowances.

2) Ledger mapping (journal entry posted when credit memo applied):
- Debit: Revenue Contra (GLA 4105) — $12,500
- Credit: Accounts Receivable (GLA 1200) — $12,500

Note: If the promo was tax-exempt for Sprout's jurisdiction, we need the external tax exemption certificate attached. Otherwise treat as non-taxable adjustment and document reason code 'TRIAL_PROMO'.

3) Required references for automatic reconciliation: credit_memo_id (CM-09321), original_invoice_id (2027-08-31), external_reference (PO or internal ticket). Please have Sprout include those exact fields in their ERP posting.

4) Internal controls: AP/AR needs an email approval from the AM (Steph) and a signed authorization from Sprout (DocuSign acceptable). Once we receive the DocuSign envelope and a copy of the invoice, Accounting will post within 2 business days.

Ive attached a draft credit memo PDF template filled with the amounts — Stephanie, please review for AM approval before sending to Sprout.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Manager, Revenue Accounting | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Hi Tom,

Thanks for the patience — accounting approved the invoice-offset approach. Summary and next steps: 

1) We will issue Credit Memo CM-09321 for $12,500 and apply it directly to Invoice #2027-08-31 (invoice offset).
2) Ledger mapping when applied: Debit Revenue Contra (GLA 4105) / Credit AR (GLA 1200).
3) Please include these exact reference fields in your ERP posting: original_invoice_id=2027-08-31, credit_memo_id=CM-09321, external_reference=SproutAI-PO-7781. This will trigger automated reconciliation.
4) If your jurisdiction requires tax documentation, attach the tax exemption certificate when you post — otherwise mark the adjustment as 'TRIAL_PROMO'.
5) Control: We need a signed authorization to post. I have attached the credit memo (Redwood_credit_memo_09321.pdf) and included a DocuSign envelope link (DocuSign: 0f8b7c2a). Please sign by end of day Friday so we can post before your month-close.

If you prefer Redwood to leave the credit memo unapplied (open) instead of auto-applying, tell me explicitly and we will change the workflow (but AR will remain open).

Best regards,
Stephanie
